title: Agentic Sales Driver
description: Full-stack WhatsApp commerce system that understands buying intent, checks inventory in real time, and replies like a human sales assistant. Built as an agentic workflow for faster conversions and lower support load.

caseStudy.headline: Agentic Sales Driver: Autonomous AI for WhatsApp-Based Retail Selling
caseStudy.summary: An AI-powered system that turns customer messages into sales by understanding intent, checking inventory, and responding like a human sales assistant.
problems: Manual and delayed replies lead to lead drop-off before purchase intent can convert.
Chat-based selling often lacks structured attribution and intent visibility.
Growth usually means hiring more support staff instead of improving the system.
Most stores have data, but no intelligence layer between inventory and the customer.
caseStudy.architecture: I built an agentic sales system that parses customer messages, extracts structured buying intent, matches live inventory, and responds contextually through an automated backend workflow.

workflow.title: Webhook/API Intake
workflow.desc: Real-time customer messages are captured from the WhatsApp layer and routed into the FastAPI backend for processing.

workflow.title: LLM Intent Parsing
workflow.desc: Unstructured chats are transformed into structured intent data like product, quantity, variation, and buying signals.

workflow.title: Inventory Check
workflow.desc: The system verifies real-time availability and pricing before the assistant makes any commitment to the customer.

workflow.title: AI Response Generation
workflow.desc: A context-aware response is created in brand voice and sent back as a guided sales reply.

features.title: Autonomous Chat Handling
features.desc: Handles end-to-end sales conversations without human intervention unless escalation is needed.

features.title: Natural Language Product Extraction
features.desc: Understands messy customer messages, vague product references, and shorthand buying requests.

features.title: Real-time Inventory Awareness
features.desc: Prevents bad promises by grounding every answer in live product availability and pricing.

hurdles: Managing highly ambiguous slang and unstructured retail chat patterns.
Maintaining conversation context across multiple sessions and follow-ups.
Guarding the model against inventory hallucinations and unsupported promises.
roadmap: Direct payment link generation inside the chat flow
Lower-cost specialized models for high-volume inference
caseStudy.ctaText: Currently accepting select projects for agentic system design and AI infrastructure.

title: ReqScan AI Analyzer
description: Advanced Requirement Analyzer that transforms unstructured technical specifications into validated BRDs and system architecture maps. Utilizes RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) for precision accuracy.

caseStudy.headline: ReqScan AI Analyzer: From Raw Requirements to Build-Ready Clarity
caseStudy.summary: An AI-assisted requirement analysis system that transforms ambiguous documents into structured BRDs, architectural signals, and implementation-focused insights.
problems: Requirement docs often arrive vague, inconsistent, and overloaded with business language.
Product and engineering teams lose time converting raw notes into structured deliverables.
Missing edge cases and unclear dependencies create downstream architectural mistakes.
Traditional documentation workflows are slow, manual, and hard to scale across projects.
caseStudy.architecture: ReqScan combines LLM reasoning with retrieval-backed context to extract requirements, identify missing logic, and produce structured outputs that accelerate planning, validation, and system design.

workflow.title: Document Intake
workflow.desc: Requirement documents, client notes, and raw technical descriptions are uploaded into the analysis pipeline.

workflow.title: LLM Requirement Parsing
workflow.desc: The system breaks down vague or unstructured input into actors, modules, constraints, dependencies, and system expectations.

workflow.title: Knowledge Retrieval
workflow.desc: Relevant context is pulled from indexed reference material and domain memory to improve precision and reduce ambiguity.

workflow.title: Structured Output Generation
workflow.desc: ReqScan generates refined BRDs, architecture-aligned insights, and implementation-ready summaries for product teams.

caseStudy.techTagline: Built for analysis precision and scalable workflows

features.title: Requirement Intelligence
features.desc: Turns scattered project notes and client language into structured requirement artifacts teams can actually build from.

features.title: Context-Aware Analysis
features.desc: Uses retrieval to ground outputs in supporting material rather than relying on generic model assumptions.

features.title: Architecture-Ready Outputs
features.desc: Surfaces modules, workflows, risks, and system-level concerns early so product and engineering stay aligned.

hurdles: Handling incomplete, contradictory, or business-heavy requirement language.
Reducing hallucinations when the source document lacks technical precision.
Producing outputs that are useful for both stakeholders and engineering teams.
roadmap: Automatic user story and acceptance criteria generation
Visual architecture diagram suggestions from parsed requirements
Multi-document comparison for change tracking and scope drift
Domain-specific analysis templates for SaaS, ERP, and AI products
caseStudy.ctaText: Available for AI product design, requirement intelligence, and developer workflow automation projects.
